datasets.name: Pleiades
datasets.attribution: Pleiades: A Gazetteer of Past Places, pleiades.stoa.org (CC BY 3.0)
datasets.notes: Dates are broad archaeological periods (e.g. Roman = 30 BCE–300 CE), not founding dates. Pleiades does not record settlement size.

datasets.name: Ancient World Mapping Center
datasets.attribution: Ancient World Mapping Center, UNC Chapel Hill — geodata derived from the Barrington Atlas (ODbL)
datasets.notes: Road and shoreline dates are Barrington periods. Inland water is modern-based (OSM). Dates for non-Roman snapshots are the conventional dates of the extents their titles name.

datasets.name: Cliopatria (Seshat Global History Databank)
datasets.attribution: Cliopatria, Seshat Global History Databank (CC BY 4.0); simplified by Shelf
datasets.notes: One scholarly version of each polity’s territory; borders were rarely this sharp. Kingdom/empire/republic types come from Wikidata where available.

datasets.name: Wikidata
datasets.notes: Battles, sieges and campaigns with a location and a date. Crowd-sourced; check important facts.

datasets.name: Natural Earth
datasets.notes: Modern coastline and modern river courses. Rivers and coasts have moved since antiquity; ancient coastlines come from AWMC.
